hr.style: background-color:#eeeeee; border:medium none; clear:both; display:block; font-size:0px; min-height:1px; line-height:0; margin:0 0 20px 0;

div.p:
A sign-in link was requested for the account linked to this email. Use the button below to sign in.
This link can only be used once and will expire shortly.

a.t-attf-style: background-color: {{object.company_id.email_secondary_color or '#875A7B'}}; padding:8px 16px; text-decoration:none; color: {{object.company_id.email_primary_color or '#FFFFFF'}}; border-radius:5px; font-size:13px; display:inline-block;

div.p: If you did not request this sign-in link, you can safely ignore this email.
